_comment: The station line (see Starbases.cs): one station per body, grown tier by tier. Each tier is a hull like a ship class (slots, power, heat, armour) with no engine; bays (slot B, modules in ship-classes.json) do the jobs. Upgrading to the next tier costs the difference in Industry and takes half its days; swapping bays is a refit. Reaches are in Mm: rail batteries and station railguns 40, missile silos and station missiles 60, the point defence umbrella over fleets in orbit 12.
_gunsComment: Station guns: each railgun mount hits railDamagePerHour at fleets in low and high orbit, each missile rack mount (8 missiles) missileDamagePerHour; they burn ammunition goods from the station's own store (railAmmoPerHour, missileAmmoPerHour per mount). With an empty store they fire at emptyGunShare (as planet guns do), which is how a captured station fires until its new owner's ammunition reaches it. A ring's guns reach far orbit too.
_fleetComment: Friendly fleets holding low orbit under a station: its point defence adds umbrellaShare of its mounts to theirs, a magazine rearms them (missiles too), a fuel depot refuels them from the station's store, a repair hangar or dock bay mends them at the dry dock rate. A fleet that was mending takes undockHours to get away when ordered off.
_siegeComment: Far orbit: out of every reach (bar a ring's), but no blockade, bombing or landing from there. High orbit bombs at highOrbitBombShare. Tier 4 and up doubles (landingFactor) the garrison troops must beat. A station is boarded like a ship: garrisonK troops per tier defend it (scaled by armour left, x2 while its guns still fire).
_minesComment: Fields laid round a planet drift thin (driftPerDay of their mines a day) and cost upkeep in Industry per 10 mines a day.

tiers.blurb: A pressurised can with a docking collar: refuels and rearms your fleets in orbit, and watches it.
An armoured fort with railguns and point defence: guns into low and high orbit; enemy warships must beat it before they can blockade.
The base: repair hangar, magazine and a great slipway that lays down hulls up to 260 m.
Capital-grade guns, heavy armour and shields. While it stands, troops landing need twice the strength.
A ring round the whole world: every shell covered, a capital slip, and it doubles as the space elevator.

classes.name: Orbital platform
classes.role: Refuels and rearms your fleets in orbit, so they stop flying home.

classes.name: Defence station
classes.role: Guns into low and high orbit, point defence over the planet. Must be beaten or passed before a fleet can hold orbit.

classes.name: Starbase
classes.role: Repairs and rearms in orbit, lays down hulls up to 260 m, spots for the fleet. Keeps your fleet in the field instead of flying home.

classes.name: Fortress
classes.role: Hits like two cruisers and soaks a siege. While it stands, a landing needs twice the troops.

classes.name: Orbital ring
classes.role: Every shell covered, no safe height anywhere. Lays down any hull, and doubles as the space elevator.
